# HCommandPalette

> A searchable keyboard command dialog with grouping, shortcuts, and disabled commands.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.5.1. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HCommandPalette` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-command-palette>`.
- Constructor: `HearthCommandPaletteElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Controls.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HCommandPalette.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Search includes labels, descriptions, groups, and keywords. Disabled commands cannot execute.
- Global Ctrl/Cmd+K binding is opt-in with shortcut=true; enable it on only the intended palette. The component requests actions and never owns the router.

## Public API

items: CommandItem[] · open, shortcut: boolean · label, placeholder: string

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    open?: boolean;
    items: CommandItem[];
    label?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    shortcut?: boolean;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{
    items: () => [],
    label: "Command palette",
    placeholder: "Search commands…",
  }
```

### Events

update:open(boolean), close(), select(id), search(query)

```ts
type Emits = {
    "update:open": [
        open: boolean
    ];
    close: [
    ];
    select: [
        id: string
    ];
    search: [
        query: string
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

list, option (dialog parts are also exposed)

Use `hearth-command-palette::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface CommandItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    description?: string;
    icon?: string;
    group?: string;
    shortcut?: string;
    keywords?: string[];
    disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { HCommandPalette, HButton } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';
const open = ref(false);
const commands = [{id:'apps',label:'Open applications',group:'Navigate',icon:'apps'},{id:'settings',label:'Open settings',group:'Navigate',icon:'settings'}];
function run(id: string) { /* Route or execute the selected command. */ }
</script>

<template>
  <HButton @click="open=true">Find an action</HButton>
  <HCommandPalette v-model:open="open" :items="commands" @select="run" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-command-palette');
Object.assign(element, {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "apps",
      "label": "Open applications",
      "group": "Navigate",
      "icon": "apps"
    },
    {
      "id": "settings",
      "label": "Open settings",
      "group": "Navigate",
      "icon": "settings"
    }
  ]
});

element.addEventListener('update:open', event => { element.open = event.detail[0]; });
const trigger = document.createElement('button'); trigger.textContent = 'Find an action'; trigger.addEventListener('click', () => { element.open = true; }); mount.before(trigger);

mount.append(element);
```

- [HCombobox](../combobox/llms.txt): Searchable single or multi-select with selected chips, disabled options, keyboard navigation, and repeated form values.
